labels.label: context
labels.reason: It is an introductory pointer that explains the migration paths and states that version 16 has incompatibilities listed below, with no specific action itself.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Assignment rules for PL/pgSQL bound cursor variables changed, so existing code relying on the old name-matching behavior must be modified to assign the portal name before OPEN.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: NULLS NOT DISTINCT indexes can no longer be used for primary keys, so schemas relying on them will fail and need changes.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: REINDEX DATABASE and reindexdb no longer process system catalog indexes, so scripts relying on that must add REINDEX SYSTEM or reindexdb --system.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Inherited and partitioned tables must now share the same generation status, which can require schema changes for existing tables that mix generated and non-generated columns.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The pg_walinspect functions pg_get_wal_records_info_till_end_of_wal() and pg_get_wal_stats_till_end_of_wal() were removed, so any code calling them will break.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The server variable force_parallel_mode was renamed to debug_parallel_query, so configuration files and scripts setting the old name will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Creating views manually with ON SELECT rules is no longer allowed, so any code or tooling doing this must be rewritten to use CREATE VIEW.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The server variable vacuum_defer_cleanup_age was removed, so configurations that set it will fail to start or load.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The server variable promote_trigger_file was removed, so standby promotion scripts relying on it must switch to pg_ctl promote or pg_promote().

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The read-only server variables lc_collate and lc_ctype were removed, so any code or monitoring that reads them must change.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Role inheritance behavior changed so member inheritance is set at GRANT time, which alters privilege behavior for existing role memberships and may require review or use of the new WITH INHERIT clause.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: CREATEROLE holders now need ADMIN OPTION to modify other roles, so existing roles and admin workflows may lose privileges and fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: Symbolic links for the postmaster binary were removed, so scripts or services that invoke postmaster via those links will break.
